args.body: Hi Dora, I recently visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). I appreciate that you make it easy for visitors to reach you by including your email address. However, the site is quite minimal at the moment - it would be great to see more content about who you are, your background, projects(), or interests. Adding sections like an About page, a portfolio, or blog posts could make your website more engaging and give visitors a better sense of your personality. Overall, it's a good starting point with clear potential for growth!

Hi Eve, I recently visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking - it gives readers a personal glimpse into your interests! I'd suggest expanding the blog with more content, such as stories from your favorite hikes, trail recommendations, tips for fellow hikers, or photos from your adventures. Adding these details could really bring your blog to life and attract like-minded readers who share your enthusiasm for the outdoors. Keep up the great work!
